liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He Was A Friend Of Mine** (3 reviews, 1 other source): Features an unusually long opening guitar solo, the longest this listener had heard on the song; Runs just over thirteen minutes (13:16) [3][4][6][11]
- **Green Green Grass Of Home** (1 review): Pedal steel guitar is featured on this song [7]
- **Sittin' On Top Of The World** (1 review): Singled out as an excellent version [8]
- **High Time** (1 review): Starts somewhat ragged but settles into a beautiful performance [7]
- **Me And My Uncle** (1 other source): This song is cut in this version of the recording [3]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Reviewer finds this a distinctive treatment of the song, better than usual [11]
- **Slewfoot** (1 review): Pedal steel is featured; reviewer thinks it could have fit a later cowboy medley despite silly lyrics [7]

## Setlist highlights

- **Green Green Grass Of Home**: rare: 8 archived performances [16]
- **Ol' Slewfoot**: rare: 4 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-07-03.132377.sbd.miller.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 10 songs; 85 min; rated 2.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1969-07-03.121879.sbd.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 8 songs; 50 min; rated 3.75/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound is clear, with every instrument and voice distinct [11]
- **gd1969-07-03.sbd.miller.92771.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 7 songs; 44 min; rated 3.5/5 by 14 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds sound quality good, with Garcia sounding good; jams have a psychedelic country feel; Reviewer describes the recording as distorted [12][14]

## Around the show

- Show took place near the USAF Academy in Colorado Springs; reviewer jokes cadets may have skipped class [6]
- Held at a ranch hosting rock shows in a quonset-style hut; band's drug use was visible to the audience [13]
- Garcia was reportedly so out of it that Phil tuned his guitar; tuning problems persisted, with a rocky start [13]
- Attendee says the venue was a very large barn, and the band didn't start until around 3am [14]
- Attendee describes a packed crowd of heads and a mini-Woodstock atmosphere [14]
- Garcia plays pedal steel at this show [15]
- Listener says anything from these peak 1969 months deserves concentrated listening [4]
- Reviewer calls this one of the Dead's off nights [13]
- Includes early renditions of a couple of Workingman's Dead tunes alongside Pigpen numbers and country songs [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-07-03.132377.sbd.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Soundboard to cassette master to DAT to MP3; DAT lent by Rob Eaton; Patches for Me And My Uncle, He Was A Friend Of Mine and Lovelight came from the dead.net taper's section stream; Joe B. Jones helped pitch-correct the patch source [1]
- **gd1969-07-03.121879.sbd.miller.flac16**: taped by Rob Eaton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) [2]. Also: Patch source is the dead.net taper's section mp3 stream, pitch-corrected with help from Joe B. Jones; Rob Eaton lent the DAT used for this transfer [2]
- **gd1969-07-03.sbd.miller.92771.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Rob Eaton and Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by gravitystereo: [Grateful Dead - Ol Slewfoot ( 2 CD SET ) ( Reed´s Ranch, Colorado Springs, Colorado,July 3rd 1969 ) - gravitystereo](https://gravitystereo.com/product/grateful-dead-ol-slewfoot-2-cd-set-reeds-ranch-colorado-springs-coloradojuly-3rd-1969/) [17]
